tasks.question: At 1400, what geographic extent can evidence tied to Kilwa itself safely support, and what wider Swahili-coast inference must remain unmade?
What can be shown about slavery/coercion evidence associated with a transregional network without converting route participation into territorial practice along the entire network?
At 1700, what can safely be visualized for a community/archipelago frame whose historical social and spatial boundaries are not one resolved polity polygon?
Which registered targets remain C0-only/unresearched, and can that state be seen spatially without blank areas implying 'no slavery'?
What is the strongest bounded conclusion for this one institution at 1100, and does a map add anything material beyond a competent register entry?

baseline: compact register + conventional static map/GIS with identical geometries, year/frame/outcome filters and citations
atlas: same evidence/geometries plus explicit claim layers, inference extent, research state, geometry certainty and selected-year applicability
